mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over two consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate lower borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a 3-month moving average, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate indicates monetary tightening coupled with economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate profitability and risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises simultaneously, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing boom regime (HOUST > 1800 thousand units), rising home construction activity stimulates consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1800, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to real-time economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises for two consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.05 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as real rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% annualized, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), strong job creation boosts consumer spending and corporate revenue, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly, or Rank IC is below 0.05 over any 6-month rolling window.
